cohorts.title: Native 100/40 · 150 input / 8 output tokens

RSS is process memory; GPU compute and uncharged GPU allocations remain unmeasured. Public-prefix rows reuse 96 public tokens; artifact distribution and physical wire overhead are excluded.

cohorts.title: Native 100/40 · masked-wire key encoding · 30 + 2 tokens
cohorts.scope: Same unfused Q12 mapping, optimized CPU implementation and overlapped dispatch; full versus fresh party-local seeded key packets. One cold 30+2-token response per isolated client, native shared 100/40 caps, cached checkpoint and two co-located CPU workers. Outputs match. Physical wire, checkpoint download, Internet RTT, representative quality and independent operators remain unmeasured. Earlier dispatch and clear-SiLU cohorts retain separate identities.
